definitions.explanation: A promise or agreement made only in words, with nothing in writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{口約束|くちやくそく}だった。
examples.english: It was only a verbal promise.

examples.japanese: {口約束|くちやくそく}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧だ。
examples.english: A verbal promise alone isn't reassuring.

examples.japanese: {口約束|くちやくそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}する→成立する：25497_seiritsusuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧よう⟦{書面|しょめん}→書面：13023_shomen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: A contract can be made by spoken agreement alone, but it's better to put it in writing so it doesn't lead to a dispute later.

notes:
⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (mouth, spoken words) + ⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧ (promise). Often implies that the promise may not be kept or cannot be proved.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口約束|くちやくそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make a verbal promise
- ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{口約束|くちやくそく}: a mere verbal promise
- {口約束|くちやくそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}る→破る：02321_yaburu⟧: to break a verbal promise

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{口頭|こうとう}→口頭：11892_koutou⟧: oral, by word of mouth (formal; ⟦{口頭|こうとう}→口頭：11892_koutou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧)
- ⟦{書面|しょめん}→書面：13023_shomen⟧: in writing (the opposite)
